thūpa.cp: masc. a tope; pagoda; a cairn; a monument erected over the ashes of a holy person.
thūpa.p: [Thūpa+a] (pu,na) CL=7 [Thūpiyati rāsikarīyatīti thūpo, atha vā thūpati thirabhāvena vuddhiṃ viruḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjamāno patiṭṭhātīti thūpo. Apa, ṭṭha, 2. 154.(nīti, dhā. 326-See also). Thu+pa. Thuabhitthave, po, dīghādi. Dhāna, ṭī. 436. (mahā-nipāta, nimijāta, ṭī. Pe. Ṇvādi. 115-laññaḥkrañña့).(stūpa-saṃ)] (1) Shrine (sacred depository or pagoda enshrining sacred objects), Stupa with a vaulted base (Vault of sacred relics), (A) A pagoda in which have vault of sacred relics). (B) A pagoda in which without vault of sacred relics. (C) Pagoda in which has a cave. (D) A pagoda in which hasn't a cave. (E) The treasure pagoda, Golden pagoda. (F) Ruby pagoda. (G) Pagoda which built with bricks. (H) A pagoda which is made with earth. (I) A pagoda in which enshrines the bone (such as human's bone as remembrance). (J) A pagoda which is built with sand. (K) A pagoda which is made with bamboo., A pagoda which is made with thin bamboo strips. (2) It is the depended place (or) supporter. (The nature) of liberation due to overwhelm and  elevate. (4) Mound, The ground which is elevated place. See original. Thūpa(na) [thūpa+cīvara. Cancel behind word]. (A) Robe which should be made a devotional offering at the mound. (B) The robe which should wrap and cover the mound. See also - Thūpacīvara.

H: thūpa：m．[Sk．sthūpa] 塔，塔婆，佛塔．-āraha 值得建塔（紀念）的（worthy of a tope）．-cīvara 塔衣．-pūjā 塔供養．
S: thūpa：m．[Sk．sthūpa] 塔，塔婆，仏塔．-āraha 塔に価する．-cīvara塔衣．-pūjā 塔供養．

[ထူပ+အ။ ထူပိယတိ ရာသိကရီယတီတိ ထူပေါ၊ အထ ဝါ ထူပတိ ထိရဘာဝေန ဝုဒ္ဓိံ ဝိရုဠှိံ ဝေပုလ္လံ အာပဇ္ဇမာနော ပတိဋ္ဌာတီတိ ထူပေါ။ အပ၊ ဋ္ဌ၊ ၂။ ၁၅၄။ （နီတိ၊ ဓာ။ ၃၂၆-လည်းကြည့်）။ ထု+ပ။ ထုအဘိတ္ထဝေ၊ ပေါ၊ ဒီဃာဒိ။ ဓာန်၊ ဋီ။ ၄၃၆။ （မဟာ-နိပါတ်၊ နိမိဇာတ်၊ ဋီ။ ပေ။ ဏွာဒိ။ ၁၁၅-လည်းကြည့်）။ （သ္တူပ-သံ）]
C: thūpa：[m．] a tope； pagoda； a cairn； a monument erected over the ashes of a holy person．
P: Thūpa，[Vedic stūpa，crown of the head，top，gable； cp．Gr．stu/pos （handle，stalk）．Oicel．stūfr （stump），to *steud as in tudati] a stupa or tope，a bell-shaped pile of earth，a mound，tumulus，cairn； dome，esp．a monument erected over the ashes of an Arahant （otherwise called dhātugabbha=dāgaba），or on spots consecrated as scenes of his acts．In general as tomb：Vin．IV，308； J．III，156 （mattika°）=Pv．I，84； in special as tope：D．II，142，161，164 sq．； A．I，77； M．II，244； J．V，39 （rajata°）； VvA．156 （Kassapassa bhagavato dvādasayojanikaṁ kanaka°）； Ud．8； Pv III，105．Four people are thūpârahā，worthy of a tope，viz．a Tathāgata，a Tathāgatasāvaka，a Paccekabuddha，a Cakkavattin D．II，143= A．II，245．-- At Dpvs VI，65 th．is to be corrected into dhūpaṁ．（Page 309）

thūpikā.p: [Thu(thū)pa+ṇvu+ā] (thī) CL=7 [thupa samussāye, cu. Thupeti, thupayati. Ayaṃ pāṇinidhātu....thūpasamussāye, cu, ūdīghādyāyaṃ. Samussāyo ārohoubbedho. Thūpeti, thūpayati, thūpo, yūpikāti aggavaṃsācariyo. Nūtadhātumālā. 60.(nīti, dhā. 326- See also). (stūpikā-saṃ)]. The pinnacle of (mansion or many tiered etc.,), finial.
a: ထုပ သမုဿာယေ၊ စု။ ထုပေတိ၊ ထုပယတိ။ အယံ ပါဏိနိဓာတု။...ထူပသမုဿာယေ၊ စု၊ ဦဒီဃာဒျာယံ။ သမုဿာယော အာရောဟောဥဗ္ဗေဓော။ ထူပေတိ၊ ထူပယတိ၊ ထူပေါ၊ ယူပိကာတိ အဂ္ဂဝံသာစရိယော။ နူတဓာတုမာလာ။ ၆ဝ။(နီတိ၊ ဓာ။ ၃၂၆-လည်းကြည့်)။(သ္တူပိကာ-သံ)] (ပြာသာဒ်-စသည်၏)- အထွတ်၊ စုလစ်မွန်းချွန်။
